name: Bito
tagline: AI Code Review Agent for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket with repo-aware reviews, custom guidelines, Jira integration, and analytics.
pricing: Team $12/seat/mo annual ($15 monthly); Professional $20/seat annual ($25 monthly), 14-day trial; both include 5K LOC reviewed/seat/mo, then $5 per extra 1K lines
selfHostedNote: bito.ai/pricing confirms self-hosted deployment of the review agent from the Professional tier (+$5/seat/mo, vs. Bito-hosted by default); Enterprise adds full on-prem/multi-org deployment. Docs also detail self-managed-git guides for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.0+, GitLab Self-Managed 15.5+, and Bitbucket self-managed.
modelControl: No BYOK documented for AI Code Reviews specifically; vendor-managed models (built on Claude per Bito's case studies), with free Basic vs. paid-tier Advanced (GPT-4o/Claude) model tiers in the IDE/CLI extensions. BYOK exists on Bito's separate Governor product, not confirmed for Code Reviews.
